title: Elastic Container Registry (ECR) & Elastic Container Service (ECS) & Fargate

cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
Today, we're talking about the Elastic Container Service, or ECS for short, which is a fully managed container orchestration service that helps you run, manage, and scale
cues.zh: 今天談 Elastic Container Service，ECS，全受管容器協調服務，協助在 AWS 執行、管理、擴展

cues.en: docker containers on AWS.
All right, let's have a look.
So, ECS comes into deployment options.
You can deploy ECS on EC2.
That's the first deployment option.
And basically, here's our architecture.
We've got our availability zones.
We're going to need to launch some EC2 instances.
So we provision these EC2 instances ourselves.
cues.zh: 自己佈建這些執行個體。

cues.en: They will be put into what is called an ECS cluster, and then we can now deploy our docker containers
cues.zh: 放進 ECS 叢集，再部署 Docker 容器，

cues.en: on these two instances.
So ECS will deploy them for us.
There's different rules that it can follow.
It can try to maximize the utilization of each two instance before it moves on to the next one.
cues.zh: 例如先最大化某 EC2 使用率，再換下一個。

cues.en: It can, on the other hand, so like we're seeing here, it's maximize this one, then it's moved on to this one, and then it's deploying the rest.
cues.zh: 像這裡，先填這個，再移這個，然後部署剩下的。

cues.en: It could follow a different rule where it uses as little as possible on each EC2 instance, to spread out the docker containers to increase availability.
cues.zh: 也可各 EC2 用少一點，分散容器，提高可用性。

cues.en: Those are quite advanced things we don't need to know for the CCP exam.
cues.zh: 較進階，CCP 考試不需知道。

cues.en: What we might need to know is that, what we definitely need to know is that we need to provision these EC2 instances, and they're called an ECS cluster.
cues.zh: 一定需要知道的是，自行佈建 EC2，它們組成 ECS 叢集。

cues.en: And also this is ECS cluster can integrate with the Elastic Load Balancer and autoscaling groups.
cues.zh: 也可整合 Elastic Load Balancer、自動擴展群組。

cues.en: And, now the second option is ECS on Fargate.
And this is a serverless option.
So remember that for the exam. It's a serverless option.
Again, here we have our availability zones.
Now, we also have an ECS cluster, but it's effectively just a Fargate resource.
cues.zh: 也有 ECS 叢集，但實際使用 Fargate 資源。

cues.en: We don't know the, we don't have control over the servers behind it.
cues.zh: 不知道、不控制後面伺服器。

cues.en: We don't need to provision any servers.
So we just launch our containers whenever we need to, and Fargate will decide itself where to place them.
cues.zh: 需要時啟動容器，Fargate 自行決定位置。

cues.en: We don't have to worry about that at all.
So it's a very, very convenient option.
So just remember for the exam that you don't have to manage any infrastructure with Fargate.
cues.zh: 記住 Fargate 不必管理基礎設施。

cues.en: It is a serverless option.
And finally, we have what is called the ECR Registry or the Elastic Container Registry where you can store container images.
cues.zh: 最後 ECR，Elastic Container Registry，儲存容器映像。

cues.en: And these images is what is used to launch the containers themselves.
So just like we had the EBS snapshots or Amazon Machine Images or AMIs, similarly, we have these container images and from them you can launch
cues.zh: 類似 EBS 快照、AMI，也有容器映像，由此啟動

cues.en: your different containers.
So, there we go.
That's what ECS is all about, and Fargate, and ECR.
Just remember for the exam that ECS comes into deployment options.
cues.zh: 考試記住 ECS 兩種部署。

cues.en: On the EC2 version, you need to provision instances.
In the Fargate version, it's serverless.
You don't need to manage infrastructure.
And ECR is the registry that allows you to store containers.
cues.zh: ECR 是儲存容器映像的登錄庫。

cues.en: And overall, ECS allows you to launch these containers on AWS.
cues.zh: 整體 ECS 讓你在 AWS 啟動容器。

cues.en: So, here's a quick summary of what we discussed.
I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
And until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
